description: Assembler pass-1 advanced PC by 4 per source line, but 'li' with a 32-bit constant expands to 2 words (lui+addi). Labels after any wide 'li' were misplaced, so 'jal ra, addfn' jumped into the middle of the pass/fail block instead of addfn. Not-taken branches masked it; the far jal exposed it.
notes: Found via per-cycle pipeline trace: c83 idpc=0x17c decoded as 'lui t1,1', not 'add a0,a0,a1'. RTL was correct.

description: SVA property A_SRA specified as 'y == ($signed(a) >>> b[4:0])'. Because y is unsigned, Verilog context-determined signedness makes the whole compare unsigned, degrading >>> to a LOGICAL shift, so the property mismatched the (correct) arithmetic-shift RTL. Verification-collateral bug, not an RTL defect: 200k random vectors passed for all other ALU ops.
notes: Fix: compute expected in a 'wire signed [31:0]' so >>> stays arithmetic. Also add disable iff(!rst_n) to ALU/regfile SVA to skip reset-time X.
